evidence_quote: Time taken by Brianna to read 1 page = 1 minute.
question_evidence_quote: Carole can read as fast as Anna but at half the speed of Brianna.
observed_error: The response assigns Brianna one minute per page despite correctly stating that she reads twice as fast as Carole.
violated_condition: Brianna's time per page must be half Carole's one minute per page.
error_description: The response assigns Brianna one minute to read one page, contradicting the stated speed relationship: she reads twice as fast as Carole and therefore needs half her time per page. It also labels half of one minute as the time for 100 pages, omitting the page-count factor.
secondary_errors: The expression for the 100-page reading time omits multiplication by 100; evaluating one-half times one as 0.5 is arithmetically correct.
